Name: Poolhouse - New Building
Author: OMEGAlinc
Description:
Adds a new building, the Poolhouse. (Created with i18n for easy translating.)




[img]https://i.ibb.co/kxFc96g/compatibility.png[/img]
Compatible with Stardew Valley 1.6.14+.
Compatible with SMAPI 4.1.8+.


[img]https://i.ibb.co/ZxxPTf9/how-to-use.png[/img]
Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url].
Put the [CP] Poolhouse Building folder into Stardew Valley/Mods.
Load Stardew Valley using SMAPI.﻿
Build the building at Robin's.
